//commissioning-note: PRODUCTION-COMMISSIONING-1 (2026-09-17): the 15 cron entries that lived here were REMOVED. A live Vercel deployment running a build 135 commits behind production was executing them against the production database -- including /api/internal/queue/run every minute, alongside /autopilot/run, /campaigns/feed, /campaigns/activate-due, /queue/retry and the seller-flow follow-up legs, none of which had production cron authority. That made two executors on one send queue, one of them stale. The single governed scheduler is now PRODUCTION_CRON_JOBS in infra/cloudflare/worker/index.ts; the two lanes worth keeping (workflows/runtime-tick, queue/reconcile) were moved there under their own per-job flags. Do not re-add crons here.
